atoms.b: This diagram shows an ((++airport elevator)). They are the homes of aeroplanes because it is where aeroplanes take-off into the sky, land after a long flight and stay when they are not flying.

There are many different ((++buildings plants)) at an airport and each one has a different purpose. Some are only for ((++aeroplanes volcanos)), others for cars and some only for passengers and staff.
For example, the ((++runway airport_hotel)) looks like a motorway, but it is only for aeroplanes. They use it to take off and land safely.

Every day, hundreds of aeroplanes land at an airport. The ((++control_tower car_park)) is one of the most important buildings at an airport. Airport workers sit in the tower and talk to the ((++pilots cyclists)) of the aeroplanes to tell them when they should start and land, so that there are never too many aeroplanes on the runway.
Many airports have a ((airport_hotel ++car_park)) for the passengers’ cars. It is often very close to the main building of the airport.
The main building of the airport is called the ((++terminal playground)). Inside this building, passengers wait for their flights.
